steps.body: Counting keeps going past 20. After 20 comes 21, 22, 23 — the same pattern as 1, 2, 3.
steps.narration: Counting keeps going past twenty. After twenty comes twenty-one, twenty-two, twenty-three — the same pattern as one, two, three.

widget.prompt: Start at 17 and count on 6. Tap where you land.

commonLandings.feedback: That's 7 hops. Count just 6 from 17 to land on 23.

widget.successFeedback: 17 and 6 more is 23 — counting sails right past 20!

predict.prompt: Counting on 6 from 17 — will you pass 20?
predict.reveal: 17 + 6 marches straight past 20: 18, 19, 20, 21, 22, 23. Twenty is a signpost, not a wall — the counting just keeps going.

cml.actionGoal: Manipulate the model and track how it represents count sequence.
invariants: The manipulated model and the mathematical relationship for count sequence must stay consistent.
misconceptions: Changing a visible feature without preserving the relationship that defines count sequence.
cml.counterfactualPrompt: What change would make the model stop representing the same mathematical relationship?

explanationVariants: The number right after 24 is the next one up: 25.
Count on one from 24 and you reach 25.

widget.prompt: What number comes right after 24? Hop one from 24 and tap where you land.

commonLandings.feedback: 23 comes just BEFORE 24. 'After' means the next one up: 25.
26 is two after. Just one after 24 is 25.

widget.successFeedback: One hop up from 24 lands on 25 — the next number.

steps.body: Each ten counts the same way. 24, 25, 26 goes just like 4, 5, 6 — with a 2 in front.
steps.narration: Each ten counts the same way. Twenty-four, twenty-five, twenty-six goes just like four, five, six — with a two in front.

widget.prompt: Drag these into counting order, smallest first.

misorderFeedback.feedback: 26 is the biggest — it goes last, not first. Start with 22.

explanationVariants: One more than 46 is the next number: 47.
Count on one from 46 to get 47.

widget.prompt: What number is one more than 46? Hop one from 46 and tap where you land.

commonLandings.feedback: 45 is one LESS. One more means count up: 47.
56 is ten more. Just one more than 46 is 47.

widget.successFeedback: One hop up from 46 lands on 47.

hints: One more means the next number.

explanationVariants: Counting up means each number is one bigger: 43, 44, 45.
43, 44, 45 goes up by one each time — that's counting order.

widget.prompt: Which list is in counting order?

options.feedback: Yes — each number is one more than the last: 43, 44, 45.
That counts DOWN. Counting order goes up: 43, 44, 45.

hints: Counting order goes up by one.
Which list gets bigger each step?

explanationVariants: 48, then 49, then 50, then 51 — the missing number is 49.
Count up from 48: the next one is 49.

widget.prompt: Fill the missing number: 48, __, 50, 51. Tap where the missing number sits.

commonLandings.feedback: 47 comes before 48. The gap after 48 is 49.
52 comes after 51. The gap between 48 and 50 is 49.

widget.successFeedback: 48, 49, 50, 51 — one hop after 48 fills the gap.

concept.body: Slow it down. After a number, count up just one. After 33 comes 34. After 34 comes 35.
concept.narration: After a number, count up just one. After thirty-three comes thirty-four. After thirty-four comes thirty-five.

explanationVariants: Count on one from 35 to get 36.

commonErrors.feedback: 34 comes before 35. After means up one: 36.
37 is two after. Just one after 35 is 36.
